user.title: Adlar Heatpump (Aurora II)
user.description: Connect via Modbus TCP (e.g. Elfin EW11 gateway).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check IP, port, and that the EW11 is online.

data_description.scan_interval: How often measurements, status and controls are read.
data_description.slow_interval: How often the shown installer parameters, limits and version info are read.

set_parameter.name: Set installer parameter
set_parameter.description: Writes one installer parameter of the heat pump, for automations. Only parameters ticked "Allow automations" in the Heat pump parameters panel can be written. The value is read back and the write is logged in the logbook.

device_id.name: Heat pump
device_id.description: The heat pump to write to.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Code of the parameter, such as P99 or L13. The DC pump registers have no code: use 0343 (control) or 0344 (output).

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value in the parameter's unit; for a choice the number of the option. A value outside the parameter's range is refused.
